about: Tag-Team Talk topics per level: one team at the front, speakers take turns on one topic (relay). Times in seconds. M.2 is the original set; M.1, M.3 and the extra M.2 topics (to 50) were written for Kru. Spin picks a random topic, no repeats until all are used. The FOR vs AGAINST version is its own game: tag-team-debate.

M.1.title: Talk
M.1.label: Topic
topics: A perfect day at the beach
The best animal in the world
What I do on the weekend
If I had a pet dragon
What I want to be in the future
Things I love about my town
A day at the swimming pool
If I lived in the sea

intro.title: Tag-Team Talk
text: One team comes to the front.
Speakers take turns talking about one topic.

intro.title: Huddle first
text: Plan with your team for 30 seconds.
Who says what? Who starts? Who finishes?

intro.title: TAG!
text: At the chime, the next speaker continues.
Keep the same topic going!

intro.title: Challenge!
text: The audience can challenge for:
a 3-second silence, repeating an idea, off topic or Thai.
